# Volodymyr Myronenko

> Embedded and software engineer in Kyiv, Ukraine. 3+ years of hardware product development: firmware, test rigs and production automation, from schematic to series production. Open to office and remote work. MSc student in Micro- and Nanoelectronics at KSE.

The site has two focuses of the same CV: embedded (default) and software. The full text of both is in index.md.

## CV

- [Website](https://volempdoge.github.io/): interactive CV with a terminal, en / ua, three themes
- [Website, Ukrainian](https://volempdoge.github.io/uk/): the same CV in Ukrainian
- [CV in Markdown](https://volempdoge.github.io/index.md): full CV with both focuses, plain text
- [CV, embedded focus](https://volempdoge.github.io/?role=embedded): web version
- [CV, software focus](https://volempdoge.github.io/?role=software): web version

## Projects
